SAFETY_BLOCKING.authority: Git, exact candidate identity, canonical Issue/PR/Milestone, human decisions, explicit authorization, and required CI
SAFETY_BLOCKING.side_effect: Block the relevant governed side effect

GOVERNANCE_PROJECTION.authority: Canonical Issues, PRs, milestones, dependencies, and their Project projection contract
GOVERNANCE_PROJECTION.side_effect: Never authorize or initiate release; block backlog/Project mutation until repository-wide read-back is clean

PRESENTATION.authority: Canonical backlog and governance records remain unchanged
PRESENTATION.side_effect: Repair or report presentation only; never authorize release or mutate backlog truth
